method: Unity PlayMode on isolated flat technical ground; original controller active, autorun, no jump, normal gravity. GaitPhase also drives existing controller footsteps. Captured every second 60 Hz tick, 120 frames at 30 Hz. No production scene change or platform-art validation.
limitation: A drawn contact-pose foot anchor is recorded in every sample: inspect world-X drift during the same stance, not just vertical coincidence. GIF has no audio. Device CPU/GPU and final platform contacts are not validated.
